statement: Ordinary two-point correlations and the corrected Elliott conjecture. Proves the ordinary two-point Chowla conjecture, with a bound $`O(X/(\log X)^c)`$ for Liouville correlation sums along fixed nonproportional affine forms, where c > 0 is absolute. More generally, proves the binary corrected Elliott conjecture for complex multiplicative functions bounded by one when one factor is uniformly nonpretentious against each fixed Dirichlet character times $`n^{it}`$ for $`|t|\le X`$.
